app.tagline: Screenshots and GIF recordings with annotations
home.screenshotHint: Select an area and annotate it
home.recordHint: Record your screen as GIF or video
home.openHint: Edit a recording and save it as GIF or video
info.ffmpegNo: not installed – GIF, APNG, WebP and PNG still work
info.wayland: Wayland detected: bind a system shortcut to the command {command}.
overlay.hint: Drag to select an area · Enter or Ctrl+C copies · Esc cancels
settings.title: Settings
overlay.error: The screenshot could not be shown.
overlay.copyTitle: Copy to clipboard (Enter, Ctrl+C or double-click)
overlay.textPlaceholder: Type text · Enter confirms · Shift+Enter new line
pin.hint: Drag to move · drag the corners or scroll to resize · Ctrl+C copies · Ctrl+N new screenshot · Esc or double-click closes
settings.filenameHelp: Placeholders in braces: yyyy MM dd HH mm ss — e.g. {yyyy-MM-dd}
record.hint: Drag the area to record · Enter records the whole screen
record.hintWithWindows: Drag the area to record, or click a window · Enter records the whole screen
record.windowTitle: Choose a single window in the system dialog
recorder.preparing: Preparing… (confirm the screen sharing if asked)
recorder.windowHint: Recording the window you chose in the system dialog.
editor.title: Editor
settings.xwaylandHelp: Keeps the recording frame and pins on top and places them exactly. Native Wayland cannot do that; the app may look slightly blurry with fractional scaling (125 %, 150 %).
editor.applyRangeTitle: Show this annotation on the frames selected in the filmstrip
editor.scopeSelectionTitle: Only on the frames selected in the filmstrip, e.g. for a click marker
editor.fxCursorTitle: A yellow circle follows the mouse
editor.fxBlockedTitle: Linux needs read access to the input devices: run  sudo usermod -aG input $USER  and log out and in again (see Settings).
settings.recordInput: Record clicks and keys during recordings
settings.recordInputHelp: For the click and key effects in the editor. Only key names are kept, in the recording's folder.
settings.inputPermission: Not possible right now: Linux needs read access to the input devices. Run this once in a terminal, then log out and in again:
recorder.title: Recording
editor.speedHint: 200 % = twice as fast, 50 % = half as fast
editor.similarHint: Pixels identical to the previous frame. 100 % = exact copies only, e.g. 99.5 % = also a blinking cursor. Their time goes to the frame that stays.
editor.nthHint: 2 = every second one. Halves the frames, the duration stays the same.
editor.hintMove: Click a frame to select · Shift/Ctrl+click for more · Drag selected frames to move them · Del deletes
editor.cropHint: Drag a frame in the preview, move it or drag its corners
editor.transitionHint: Inserts frames between this frame and the next one (after the last: back to the first).
home.deleteConfirm: Delete this recording for good? Saved GIFs and videos are kept.
